title: Pickup Wait Schedule for Wayfare Rides
content:
Free wait, wait rates and no-show waits at the pickup point differ by ride option of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**. The schedule below lists them for every ride option.

## Wait figures by ride option

| Figure | Wayfare Shared | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free wait, on-demand trip (minutes) | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 5 | 5 |
| Wait rate per billable minute | $0.28 | $0.39 | $0.39 | $0.50 | $0.55 | $0.85 | $1.00 |
| Counting of billable wait time | whole minutes, rounded down | whole minutes, rounded down | whole minutes, rounded down | whole minutes, rounded down | whole minutes, rounded down | whole minutes, rounded down | whole minutes, rounded down |
| Wait before a no-show may be marked, on-demand trip (minutes) | 2 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 10 | 10 |
| Free wait, reserved non-airport pickup (minutes) | 0 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Free wait, reserved airport pickup (minutes) | 0 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 60 | 60 |

## Definitions

- **Free wait, on-demand trip**: minutes after the driver's arrival before wait time is billed on an on-demand trip.
- **Wait rate per billable minute**: charge per billable wait minute, USD per minute.
- **Counting of billable wait time**: how billable wait time is counted — whole elapsed minutes only, partial minutes dropped.
- **Wait before a no-show may be marked**: minutes the driver must wait after arrival on an on-demand trip before a no-show may be marked.
- **Free wait, reserved non-airport pickup**: free wait on a reserved non-airport pickup, counted from the later of the reserved pickup time and the driver's arrival.
- **Free wait, reserved airport pickup**: free wait on a reserved airport pickup, counted the same way.

## Notes on the schedule

- Wayfare Shared is not offered through Wayfare Reserve, so its reserved free-wait figures are 0.
- Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV carry the longest airport free wait on a reserved pickup (60 minutes) and the longest on-demand free wait (5 minutes).
- Because billable time is counted in whole minutes rounded down, a hypothetical 3 minutes 59 seconds of billable wait counts as 3 minutes.
